data.name: Qashan
data.gender_notes: Qashan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A young horse that is ready to race and compete. The name Qashan carries the meaning “Young Horse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qashan usually hope their child will grow to embody young horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the strength and determination to overcome obstacles and achieve greatness in life
data.etymology: Qashan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qashan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قشان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من قشينة، يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالشجاعة و القوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قشان مشتق من الجذر العربي ق-ش-ن، والذي يرتبط بالشجاعة و القوة. في اللغة العربية، يعني قشينة الشخص الذي يتصف بالشجاعة و القوة في مواجهة التحديات. كما يمكن أن يرتبط بالشخص الذي يمتلك قدرة على التكيف مع الظروف الصعبة. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أن القشينة هو الشخص الذي يتصف بالحزم و العزيمة في تحقيق أهدافه.

in_urdu.name: قشان
in_urdu.meaning: قشاں نام کا مطلب ہے شجاع اور مضبوط شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: قشان نام عربی زبان کے جذر ق-ش-ن سے ماخوذ ہے، جو شجاعت اور طاقت کی علامت ہے۔ اردو میں، قشان نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو شجاع اور مضبوط ہے، جو چیلنجوں کا سامنا کرنے کی طاقت رکھتا ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب اس شخص کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے جو دلیر اور مضبوط ہے، اور جو اپنے اہداف کو حاصل کرنے کے لئے حزم اور عزائم رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़शान
in_hindi.meaning: क़शान नाम का अर्थ है शूरवीर और मजबूत व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़शान नाम अरबी भाषा के मूल से निकला है, जो कि शूरवीरता और शक्ति का प्रतीक है। हिंदी में, क़शान नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो शूरवीर और मजबूत है, जो चुनौतियों का सामना करने की क्षमता रखता है। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए चुना जाता है जो दिलेर और मजबूत है, और जो अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए दृढ़ संकल्प और उत्साह रखता है।

in_pashto.name: قشان
in_pashto.meaning: قشان نوم د قوي او شجاع کس معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: قشان نوم د عربي ژبې د ق-ش-ن ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د شجاعت او قوت نښه ده. په پښتو کې، قشان نوم د قوي او شجاع کس معنی لري، څوک چې د ننګونو سره د مقابله کولو توان لري. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي څوک چې زړور او قوي دی، او څوک چې د خپلو موخو د ترلاسه کولو لپاره پریکړه او هڅې لري.

in_english.name: Qashan
in_english.meaning: Qashan means brave and strong individual
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qashan originates from the Arabic root q-sh-n, signifying bravery and strength. In Islamic tradition, Qashan refers to an individual who embodies courage and resilience in the face of challenges. The name is associated with someone who is determined and steadfast in achieving their goals. Historically, the name Qashan has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing desirable personality traits such as valor and fortitude.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Qashan" holds significant cultural appeal, particularly in the Arab world. Horses have long been a symbol of strength, power, and freedom in Islamic tradition. In many Middle Eastern societies, horses have been a vital aspect of daily life for centuries, playing essential roles in transportation, agriculture, and warfare. The name "Qashan," meaning a young, fresh, and competitive horse, reflects the dynamic and vibrant spirit of these cultures, which value youth, energy, and the pursuit of excellence.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Qashan" can evoke profound meanings, drawing inspiration from the distinctive qualities of a young and competitive horse. It symbolizes the individual's journey towards self-improvement and striving for excellence in all aspects of life. Additionally, the Islamic concept of "Sabil-Ar-Rahman," or the Path of God, can be connected to the name, as a young horse, like a believer in the pursuit of righteousness and spiritual growth, aspires to run the race of life with determination and perseverance. Therefore, "Qashan" can serve as an inspiring reminder to always maintain a youthful, eager, and competitive spirit in the pursuit of personal growth and spiritual enlightenment.
